scope: Targeted evaluation of candidate relation instances, Chase algebra monotonicity, minimal cover reduction, and BQNF streaming cochains

properties_verified.details: Verified that F_1 ⊆ F_2 implies cell partitions under chase(F_1, J) are refined by chase(F_2, J) without regression.
Verified that permuting dependency application order produces identical cell partitions at fixpoint.
Verified that binary decomposition under Heath's Theorem produces a distinguished row in the tableau.
Verified that extraneous LHS attributes and transitive dependencies reduce deterministically to canonical minimal covers.
Verified that candidate keys form a Sperner family (antichain) with no proper subsets.
Verified that streaming CDC events with monotonic version sequences converge to identical state under arbitrary shuffle.
Verified that QuantileSketchCochain median repair is scale-invariant and error-bounded under streaming insertions.
Verified that composite clustering keys preserve monotonic ordering under prefix projection.
